gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Chunky, confident, unmistakable. Aaargh cuts every stem and curve from one gauge of tubing, while Taviraj, a classic serif, lets a gentle gap open where each curve ends and keeps its stroke contrast restrained.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Blunt, round, and loud. Aaargh keeps its bowl walls uniform from top to bottom, and Uchen, a classic serif, sets quiet thick-thin contrast beside it, so the heading shouts while the text stays dignified.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-cutive: Modern, geometric Arkhip floats its letters well apart without any thick-and-thin modulation. Cutive, a text serif, does the opposite job, with low contrast and wide tracking that give running lines a literary, refined hush.
